# kion_compliance_level (Resource)

Manages a Kion Compliance Level.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_compliance_level" "example" {
  # Required
  compliance_program_id = 1
  name                  = "example"

  # Optional
  # description = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `compliance_program_id` (Number) ComplianceProgramID of the compliance level.
- `name` (String) Name of the compliance level in the application.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the compliance level in the application.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) compliance level ID.
